registration.statement: A binary or higher multicomponent two-phase diagram is the exact finite word of complete coexistence records. Each phase is a held component-coordinate word closing exactly to the One; both phases retain the same ordered component identities, every component preserves exact exchange-support balance, and the phase-rule relation leaves component-count degree support. External zero glyphs denote structural EmptyOne only. No lever rule, Gibbs triangle, convex hull, continuum, interpolation, regression or fit enters.
registration.title: Finite exact multicomponent phase-diagram relation
